A pressure vessel for gases: 64,000 mB a block, heavy steel corners and edge beams round clear glass. It refuses liquids, and only Pressurized Conduits connect to it.
# One vessel
Gas Reservoirs that touch merge into one vessel of any shape, sharing one gas. The corners and beams run only round its outside.
- The gas fills the whole vessel evenly, not from the bottom: you see it as a tint, stronger the fuller it is. Glowing gases glow.
- Every block takes and gives the gas; a comparator on any block reads the whole vessel.

# By hand
Right-click with a Gas Cartridge to empty it into the vessel, or with an empty one to fill it.
# Breaking one
A broken Gas Reservoir keeps its share of the gas on the item; place it back on a vessel of the same gas and it joins in. Vessels holding different gases stay apart.
